propositions: Client projects running eval harnesses cannot configure a custom corpus root; hard-coded defaults in plan_replay and provider_parity write into project-local docs/experiments/ without routing through a unified config mechanism
The ledger path is hard-coded as a str default across five functions in ledger.py, tier1.py, and tier2.py with no --ledger CLI flag to override it

The genai_prices optional dependency is imported bare in ledger.py:120 although evals is a pyproject extra missing from _optional.py::EXTRAS, breaking graceful degradation for clients without the dependency
provider_parity.py:156 globs only packaged eval specs from site-packages and ignores client-supplied .rebar/evals/*.eval.yaml files
The config resolution must support CLI override > env var > file-based rebar.toml > default precedence, mirroring the _llm_str_source pattern already used for model_classes
